_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: ✅ Memory Game ready! Find the pairs!

description: Start a memory card-matching game as a study break. Optional difficulty picks the grid: easy = 4x4, medium = 6x6, hard = 8x8 (default easy). The player can also change grid size and card theme inside the game. Tracks moves, time and best score.

difficulty.description: Board size: easy = 4x4 grid (8 pairs), medium = 6x6 grid (18 pairs), hard = 8x8 grid (32 pairs). Use this for requests like "4x4" or "8x8".

title: Play Memory Game
